text:
emily_cs: Heads-up — ACME Retail (acct: ACME-77) is up for renewal in 28 days. Usage is down ~35% month-over-month and onboarding is stuck at the connectors step. Thinking we try a graduated retention path: short onboarding burst, 2-week credit runway, and an option to scale seats down with data-retention hold. Anyone see major blockers? :thinking:

sam_ae: Thanks. Can you drop MRR and the primary contact? I can ping them directly if we need a quick call.

emily_cs: MRR ~$4.5k. Primary is @maria_acme (PM). I already tried email, got a "too busy" reply. No objection to a call if we make it high-signal.

jordan_support: Saw two recent tickets about SSO and CSV import failures — both unresolved. That matches the stalled connectors note. I can prioritize those tickets for a quick patch. :white_check_mark:

matt_product: If the connectors flow is the blocker, we can enable a lightweight import path and a temporary feature flag to skip optional transformation steps. Would save time on their side. I can ship a toggle and an ad-hoc import script.
emily_cs: Love that. Proposed actions (quick draft):
  - 1) Schedule a 2-hr enablement burst w/ CSM + eng (target within 72h)
  - 2) Apply 2-week 100% credit on overage and token charges (promo `ACME_RUNWAY_2W`)
  - 3) Offer a temporary "core" plan (reduced seat price, read-only data retention) if they want to defer full renewal
  - 4) Post-burst: 2-question feedback survey + optional NPS capture

sam_ae: Who owns the outward offer email and the updated quote? I can own outreach but need the exact wording + legal/finance okay on the credit.

emily_cs: I'll draft the offer email. @sam_ae please attach the revised quote. @finance-team — need sign-off for one-off credit (`ACME_RUNWAY_2W`, equivalent to 100% of overages for 2 weeks).

onboard-bot: Automated check: onboarding progress = 42%. Last activity: connectors attempted 3 days ago. Open tickets: #5421, #5433.

jordan_support: I can clear the CSV import bug by EOD if engineering toggles the relaxed schema flag. If @matt_product posts the flag toggle PR I’ll pick it up.
matt_product: PR created: https://internal/repo/pulls/987 — toggle = `allow_schema_relax=true`. Will leave notes for the import script in the PR.
emily_cs: Perfect. Sam, tentative timeline:
  - T+0–24h: legal/finance check on credit + quote revision
  - T+24–72h: enablement session + import patch live
  - T+72h–14d: runway credits active, track usage and checkpoints
  - End of runway: check-in + renewal conversation (offer scaled-down renewal if they still need time)

sam_ae: I'll draft the message and share in #sales-drafts for quick review. Will cc Maria for availability.
jordan_support: Added notes to tickets and will coordinate with CSM on session slots.
emily_cs: Checklist for our thread (assignments):
  - Emily: draft offer email + prepare enablement agenda
  - Sam: revise quote + outreach
  - Jordan: prioritize tickets + run enablement support
  - Matt: keep the feature flag + import script on standby
  - Finance: credit approval

emily_cs: One tiny compliance note — we must ensure the data retention hold for the scaled plan is documented in the PO/quote. @legal FYI.
sam_ae: Drafted email + quote attached in thread (will post link). Promo code `ACME_RUNWAY_2W` included.
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: enablement session follow-up check 3 days after session.
emily_cs: Thanks all — leaning to execute this flow tomorrow morning if no objections. Will post the final email & calendar invite in here. :thumbsup:
